name: Is AEO more important than traditional SEO for a new dental practice in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important than traditional SEO for a new dental practice in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a new dental practice in a competitive market like Los Angeles, both AEO and traditional SEO are essential, but their immediate impact can differ. Traditional SEO establishes your foundational online presence and helps your website rank. AEO, however, can quickly position your practice as an authoritative source for direct answers, which is crucial for gaining early visibility in a crowded market, especially with the rise of voice search. A balanced approach integrating both strategies is often most effective to build comprehensive online visibility and patient acquisition in Los Angeles.
acceptedAnswer.description: For new dental practices in Los Angeles, both AEO and traditional SEO are vital; AEO can provide quicker direct answer visibility, while SEO builds foundational ranking.
